prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Roofcorp of Metro Denver** looks like a strong first call for hail damage: the results describe storm-damage work and include customer accounts of help with insurance, inspections, and cleanup. **Woodberg Roofing & Restoration** is another option; its BBB profile lists storm-damage services and includes hail-repair customer reviews.

Before choosing, get **at least three written estimates** and verify the contractor’s license for your city, insurance, permit responsibility, references, and workmanship warranty. Don’t let a roofer pressure you to sign immediately or offer to waive your insurance deductible. A roofer can document damage and discuss the process, but your insurer decides coverage.

Sources: [Roofcorp reviews](https://www.bestcoloradocontractors.com/pro/roofcorp-metro-denver/) · [Woodberg BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/co/denver/profile/roofing-contractors/woodberg-roofing-and-restoration-llc-1296-90245804)
